method: Read-only latest SQL snapshot versus research baseline; numeric SQL values and equivalent timestamps normalized. GTIN comparison includes ean/gtin/barcode numeric values only; PZN is not a GTIN. All recognition identifiers, including PZN/SKUs/URLs, retained in catalog-readback-final.json for preservation guards. No UPDATE or transaction dry-run was executed. Earlier pre-apply-catalog-readback.json used incomplete gtin-only filtering and is superseded.
